headline: Frequent Rework of Template Parsing Code
diagnosis: The file 'parse.go' is undergoing frequent reworks primarily due to compatibility upgrades with different Go versions and issues related to template parsing functionality. The recurring theme in the commit messages indicates a pattern of upgrading Go versions and fixing related bugs, which suggests underlying instability in the template parsing logic.
plan: Conduct a thorough review of the template parsing logic to identify and address any inconsistencies or bugs that may be causing repeated reworks.
Establish a comprehensive testing suite specifically for the template parsing functionality to catch issues early during Go version upgrades.
Document the expected behavior and edge cases for the template parsing to ensure clarity and reduce the likelihood of future rework.
Assign a dedicated team member to oversee the stability of the template parsing code, ensuring that changes are made with a clear understanding of their impact.
owner_hint: Only one author is responsible for changes, indicating a high bus factor.
